**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

The document contains no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Northwind. Section 12.3 goes further and expressly preserves our freedom to develop, acquire, license, sell or use any product or service, engage any supplier, and operate in any field or territory, and records that we have given no exclusivity, non-compete, MFC, minimum-volume or no-hire commitment. This satisfies the preferred position.

The only competitive covenant, § 12.4, binds Brightline (it may not develop or market a service competing with our proprietary analytics products during the term) and therefore benefits us — left untouched.
